rows.notes: Archive topic 2; uses the locked 'unidentified life-forms' (terms_028.json notes an archive title 'Unidentified Life-forms').

rows.en: <library(1)><operator(30030,1)><speed(2)>To sum up what we have discussed so far, here is the gist of it.
<operator(30030,1)><speed(2)>Different history, different people. This is a world entirely different from the one we live in.
<operator(30030,1)><speed(2)>But the appearance of the <color(5)>unidentified life-forms<ce()> lets us infer one fact: that some kind of connection has formed...
<operator(30030,1)><speed(2)>The key to that is the <book(1)>Baldora Drive<endbook()>.<thumbnail(162)>
<operator(30030,1)><speed(2)>The <book(1)>Baldora Drive<endbook()>, thought to be a mere means of ultra-long-distance transport, was actually a way to leap to another world.
<operator(30030,1)><speed(2)>The very fact that we are here proves it.

<library(2)><topic()><operator(30120,1)><speed(2)>The ones you've been calling <color(5)>unidentified life-forms<ce()> - let me explain about the <book(49)>Invaders<endbook()> and <book(73)>Antibody Coralians<endbook()>.
rows.notes: Reordered so the color span (unidentified life-forms) precedes the book spans, matching the source's clause order.

rows.en: <operator(30120,1)><speed(2)>First, <book(73)>Antibody Coralians<endbook()><thumbnail(158)> are things that suddenly appear when the <book(69)>Scub Coral<endbook()> takes heavy damage.
<operator(30120,1)><speed(2)>They're dangerous beings with a habit of attacking people indiscriminately.
<operator(30120,1)><speed(2)>Probably something the <book(69)>Scub Coral<endbook()> produces to defend itself... that's what we think.
<operator(30120,1)><speed(2)>The other, the <book(49)>Invaders<endbook()><thumbnail(159)>, are beings full of mystery. They're extraterrestrial life-forms that come flying in from deep space.
<operator(30120,1)><speed(2)>They have an aggressive nature, seeking to destroy everything on Earth.
<operator(30120,1)><speed(2)>And they act with the unknown energy known as <book(51)>Getter Rays<endbook()> as their food source.
<operator(30120,1)><speed(2)>The <book(49)>Invaders<endbook()> also have the trait of fusing with weapons and turning into <color(6)>Metal Beasts<ce()>.
<thumbdown()><operator(30120,1)><speed(2)>Either way, both remain a threat to humanity.
